integrity: The current publisher HTML and author-uploaded full article text were inspected at the q-exponential definition, Proposition 2 CDF, Theorem 1 quantile, its proof, the inference section, and the Monte Carlo generation paragraph. The Lambert–Tsallis source was checked for the defining inversion relation. A standalone checker independently verifies the exact residual identity and all four simulation-design median discrepancies.
scientific_limitations: The authors' private simulation code is unavailable, so the result establishes a defect in the published algorithm rather than certifying how every numerical table was actually generated.

The corrected shifted Lambert–Tsallis representation is real on all bounded-support cases and only on the subregion theta < 1/(q-1) for 1 < q < 3/2; outside that subregion numerical CDF inversion remains valid.
Raw moments, likelihood formulas, and empirical data fits are not reassessed except insofar as the published Monte Carlo design invokes the faulty quantile.
title: The \(q\)-deformed Lindley quantile omits the scale parameter
